data.title: TrainZilla Pricing: Coach Pro & Gym Franchise Plans
data.description: Free forever for solo coaches. Gym and franchise plans add per-location revenue dashboards and automatic coach payouts — see seat tiers and what's included.
data.keywords: gym franchise software pricing, multi-location gym management software cost, Coach Pro, gym management pricing, seat-based gym plans, franchise gym software

_rationale: Previous keywords were generic ('per client pricing') with no franchise-buyer language, even though the Gym seat tiers (GYM_STARTER/PRO/ENTERPRISE) are exactly what a multi-location evaluator searches pricing for. Title and description now name the franchise buyer directly and reference the per-location revenue dashboard feature anchor without changing any price figures.
